content.who: This baitcaster is best suited to bass, jigs, Texas rigs, moving baits, topwater, pitching, and fast line pickup in freshwater. Its spool holds practical casting-line amounts without the bulk of a deep conventional reel. Use 10-15 lb mono/fluoro for a straightforward main line, or 20-50 lb braid when you want more strength for the same diameter and can manage braid carefully on the spool.
content.setupIntro: A practical starting point for the Abu Garcia Revo Rocket LP is 20 lb braid over monofilament backing with a 10-15 lb mono/fluoro leader. A short mono base can prevent braid from slipping and can reduce how much premium line is needed, but this compact spool does not require a large backing layer. Since two lines with the same pound-test label can have different diameters, use the listed diameter of the exact line whenever it is available.
